pattern_explanation: These Portuguese words look very similar to English words because both languages drew on the same Latin and French roots. Over time their meanings drifted apart, so the look-alike forms now carry different senses in each language.
false_friend_warning: The Portuguese word sensacional means great or wonderful, not sensational. In English, sensational describes something shocking or causing public excitement, so a Portuguese speaker who says a film is sensational may mean it is excellent, while an English speaker will understand it as shocking.
